name: Gumroad Script Implementation
description: Implements a Python script for Gumroad product automation based on an approved spec.

steps.title: Implement Gumroad Publisher Script
steps.description: Read the approved spec at {{spec_path}}. Implement a robust Python script named `gumroad_publisher.py` that perfectly implements the execution tree, API contracts, failure recoveries, timeouts, and rollback mechanisms defined in the spec. The script must accept arguments/environment variables for the Gumroad token and product payload. Save the script to {{output_dir}}/gumroad_publisher.py. Also generate a requirements.txt if necessary.

steps.title: Review Gumroad Publisher Script
steps.description: Review the implemented `gumroad_publisher.py` in {{output_dir}} against the original spec at {{spec_path}}. Verify it handles all defined failure states (401, 429, timeouts, partial failures leading to ABORT_CLEANUP). Write a brief review report to {{output_dir}}/review_report.md and fix any issues in the code.
